newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux may divert to Houston if Mexico closed.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux may divert to Houston if Mexico closed.

text.p: All-cargo airline Cargolux Airlines International, said its non-stop Boeing 747 freighter flight to Mexico City which left Luxembourg earlier on Tuesday would probably divert to Houston if the Mexican capital's airport was closed due to an ash cloud from the Popcatepetl volcano.

"As we speak, the flight is en route for Mexico City but if a landing is impossible because of the volcanic activity, then a likely solution would be a stopover in Houston and a trucking operation from there to Mexico," a Cargolux official told Reuters.
Cargolux operates three weekly 747F flights to Mexico City from Luxembourg.
